title: What 9:45 Means as a Fraction
description: Reading the clock face as a fraction of the hour instead of just a time.
narration_lines: What does 9:45 mean as a fraction of the hour?
Look at where the minute hand sits on the clock face.
It's gone 45 out of the 60 minutes in the hour.
45 out of 60 simplifies to three-quarters -- three-quarters of the way around the clock.

params.hook: What does 9:45 mean as a fraction?
params.footnote: three-quarters past = 3/4 of the way around the clock
